messages:
Nikhil Rao: Heads-up - Helios Health wants an EU-only presales POC. Must be tenant-pinned to eu-south-1, BYO KMS, VPC peering, and explicit sub-processor PDF. They also want a note about any possible egress to non-EU clouds. Can we triage?
Sofie Berg: I can own pricing + AE slide. Question: do they require Dedicated or is hosted hard-pin acceptable? They flagged 'no data leaves EU' in the questionnaire.
Grace Park: Infra note: eu-south-1 capacity available on Dedicated; hosted can be locked with tenant_pin and failover disabled. Hosted lock still has control-plane metadata in EU control plane. We'll need to attest that telemetry/logs can be scoped EU-only.
Tom Becker: Ops: we can scope telemetry and metrics to EU-only for the POC. For BYO KMS we support envelope encryption; we only store encrypted DEKs. Will prepare a short attestation.
Nikhil Rao: Customer also asked for IP whitelisting for their peered VPC and a signed subproc list PDF (not just a link). They want cert bundles exchanged before onboarding.
Sofie Berg: Pricing ask: 5-day POC. Need delta hosted hard-pin vs dedicated reserved plus peering/setup fee and any KMS verification work. I'll sketch numbers.
Grace Park: Quick cost sketch (prelim): Dedicated mini-slab ~= ,400/week; hosted hard-pin trial ~= ,000 + KMS ops & egress ~50. Peering/setup flat fee ~50. Will refine with exact SKUs.
Tom Becker: Runbook owner? I'll create the runbook. Key steps: 1) CIDR handshake + peering config; 2) cert PEM exchange; 3) KMS ARN & policy verification; 4) deploy POC slab; 5) traceroute + request-id checks.
Nikhil Rao: Security Q: can we provide a recent EU-focused penetration test summary and a table of subprocessors + their certifications (SOC2/ISO links)?
Tom Becker: Yes, we have a March 2025 infra pen-test with EU scope. Ops will include a summary and attach internal link. I'll also export the attested subproc list and produce a signed PDF for the customer.
security-bot: Reminder: when sharing cert bundles or pen-test artifacts, use share-only links and include checksum hashes.
Sofie Berg: Can we give the customer a simple routing config snippet to paste into their packet? They'll share it with Legal.
Grace Park: Snippet to share:\n\nrouting_policy: tenant_pin\nallowed_regions: ["eu-south-1"]\nfailover: "none_unless_approved"\ntelemetry: "eu-only"\n\nNikhil Rao: Action items: Tom = runbook + ops ticket + subproc PDF; Sofie = pricing slide; Grace = infra attestation + pen-test summary; Nikhil = coordinate AE/Customer sync. Aim for first drafts by Tue 09:00 CET.
Everyone: +1
ops-bot: Ticket created: RDW-5099 - "Helios EU-south-1 POC: VPC peering + BYO KMS + subproc attestation" assigned to @tom.b
Tom Becker: Will upload runbook + cert checklist to /deals/Helios/poc and ping when ready (ETA 20h).
Sofie Berg: I'll post pricing numbers in 6h.
Nikhil Rao: Thanks team  let's keep this thread for audit. :thumbsup:
